source: CDC Check for Safety: A Home Fall Prevention Checklist for Older Adults (2015)
note: Questions and fixes follow the checklist wording. priority orders the default top hazards when no concern matches (lower first). fix_item_ids match data/prices.json.

hazards.label: Slippery tub or shower floor
hazards.question: Is the tub or shower floor slippery?
hazards.fix: Put a non-slip rubber mat or self-stick strips on the floor of the tub or shower.

hazards.label: No grab bar inside or next to the tub
hazards.question: Do you need some support when you get in and out of the tub?
hazards.fix: Have grab bars put in next to and inside the tub.

hazards.label: No grab bar next to the toilet
hazards.question: Do you need some support when you get up from the toilet?
hazards.fix: Have grab bars put in next to the toilet.

hazards.label: Dark path from bed to bathroom
hazards.question: Is the path from your bed to the bathroom dark?
hazards.fix: Put in a night-light so you can see where you're walking. Some night-lights go on by themselves after dark.

hazards.label: Light near the bed is hard to reach
hazards.question: Is the light near the bed hard to reach?
hazards.fix: Place a lamp close to the bed where it's easy to reach.

hazards.label: Throw rugs that can slip
hazards.question: Do you have throw rugs on the floor?
hazards.fix: Remove the rugs or use double-sided tape or a non-slip backing so the rugs won't slip.

hazards.label: Objects on the floor
hazards.question: Are there papers, books, towels, shoes, magazines, boxes, blankets, or other objects on the floor?
hazards.fix: Pick up things that are on the floor. Always keep objects off the floor.

hazards.label: Furniture in the walking path
hazards.question: When you walk through a room, do you have to walk around furniture?
hazards.fix: Ask someone to move the furniture so your path is clear.

hazards.label: Wires or cords across the path
hazards.question: Do you have to walk over or around wires or cords (like lamp, telephone, or extension cords)?
hazards.fix: Coil or tape cords and wires next to the wall so you can't trip over them. If needed, have an electrician put in another outlet.

hazards.label: Objects on the stairs
hazards.question: Are there papers, shoes, books, or other objects on the stairs?
hazards.fix: Pick up things on the stairs. Always keep objects off stairs.

hazards.label: Broken or uneven steps
hazards.question: Are some steps broken or uneven?

hazards.label: No light over the stairway
hazards.question: Are you missing a light over the stairway?
hazards.fix: Have an electrician put in an overhead light at the top and bottom of the stairs.

hazards.label: Only one light switch for the stairs
hazards.question: Do you have only one light switch for your stairs (only at the top or at the bottom of the stairs)?
hazards.fix: Have an electrician put in a light switch at the top and bottom of the stairs. You can get light switches that glow.

hazards.label: Stairway light bulb burned out
hazards.question: Has the stairway light bulb burned out?
hazards.fix: Have a friend or family member change the light bulb.

hazards.label: Loose or torn carpet on the steps
hazards.question: Is the carpet on the steps loose or torn?
hazards.fix: Make sure the carpet is firmly attached to every step, or remove the carpet and attach non-slip rubber treads to the stairs.

hazards.label: Loose handrails, or a handrail on one side only
hazards.question: Are the handrails loose or broken? Is there a handrail on only one side of the stairs?
hazards.fix: Fix loose handrails or put in new ones. Make sure handrails are on both sides of the stairs and are as long as the stairs.

hazards.label: Things used often are on high shelves
hazards.question: Are the things you use often on high shelves?
hazards.fix: Move items in your cabinets. Keep things you use often on the lower shelves (about waist level).

hazards.label: Unsteady step stool
hazards.question: Is your step stool unsteady?
hazards.fix: If you must use a step stool, get one with a bar to hold on to. Never use a chair as a step stool.
